equity_bridge.item: Financial assets at FVPL (private biotech stakes, funds, listed equities, structured deposits, WMPs)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 balance sheet, note 11; their FV gains/losses are excluded from EBITDA

equity_bridge.item: Simcere Zaiming redemption liability (outside investors' put, 7% accreting)
equity_bridge.note: H1 FY2026 note 19 'Other financial liability'; deducted as the NCI claim; its accretion (RMB74.5m FY2025) is non-cash and below the flows

historical_growth.notes: FY2022-FY2025 revenue 6,319 -> 7,731; FY2020-FY2025 4,509 -> 7,731. EPS FY2022 0.36 -> FY2025 0.54; FY2020 0.28 -> 0.54. Equity 5yr CAGR (12.2%) is inflated by the FY2025 RMB1,418m placing, so the 3yr equity CAGR (9.7%) is selected. Owner FCF (reported FCF - SBC): FY2022 538.4 -> FY2025 1,061.8 = 25.4%/yr, ABOVE the reported-FCF CAGR (19.4%) because SBC fell from RMB138m (FY2022) to RMB90m; SBC is not growing faster than cash flow. 5yr owner-FCF CAGR undefined (FY2020 FCF negative). Reported FCF is erratic (-829m FY2023 on RMB497m of in-licensing payments), so FCF CAGRs are not used for the path.

scenario_narratives.base: Simcere completes the pivot it is visibly making: the innovative portfolio (85% of H1 FY2026 revenue) keeps compounding as Sanbexin holds its ~31% stroke-injection share through NRDL renewals, the newly reimbursed oncology drugs (COSELA, ENLITUO, ENZESHU) and QUVIVIQ ramp, and the autoimmune franchise grows on Iremod and zemprocitinib. Out-licensing (AbbVie, NextCure, Almirall, Ipsen, Boehringer Ingelheim, Roche) keeps producing upfronts and milestones, but at a normalised ~6-7% of revenue rather than the FY2026 peak. Legacy generics run off at ~20%/yr. Revenue roughly doubles over the decade at a 29% mature EBITDA margin.
scenario_narratives.bull: The 'Innovation 2.0' platform proves repeatable: the >US$6bn of milestone potential across six partnerships starts converting, royalties on Roche's SIM0660 and Boehringer's asset begin to flow late in the decade, the Leruiping resubmission is approved, and dual US/China INDs produce further multi-hundred-million upfronts. Licensing and product mix lift EBITDA margin to 33% as selling expense leverages, and revenue compounds at low double digits.
scenario_narratives.bear: China's payer squeezes the franchise: a harsh Sanbexin NRDL renewal or VBP/generic entry on edaravone-dexborneol cuts the largest product, crowded PD-(L)1/ADC/JAK categories cap the oncology and autoimmune launches, and BD deal flow stalls after the FY2026 peak so licensing income collapses. FY2027 revenue is flat on the licensing comparison, growth then limps at 2-4%, and margins fall to 21% as the sales force is carried on a smaller product base.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value the consolidated operating pharma on owner FCF (SBC expensed, in-licensing payments treated as recurring capex), add net cash and investment securities, deduct the Simcere Zaiming investors' redemption claim and NCI. Licensing upfronts are treated as recurring at a normalised rate, not capitalised from the FY2026 peak.
key_risks_to_valuation: NRDL renewal / VBP pricing on Sanbexin and the oncology portfolio
Lumpiness of licensing income; FY2026 is a peak year (Boehringer EUR42m + Roche US$75m upfronts)
Simcere Zaiming spin-off: the minority claim after IPO may be worth more than the RMB1.22bn redemption liability deducted
In-licensing spend could re-accelerate above the 4-5%-of-revenue normalised level (RMB513m FY2025)
FVPL book (RMB1.2bn) includes private biotech stakes carried at Level-3 fair value
CNY/HKD rate moves directly through the HKD per-share value

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 9.07-14.38 HKD
data_sources.financials: 2096.HK_Metrics.csv (CNY millions); FY2025 annual report (P&L, cash flow, note 6(c) D&A, SBC reconciliation); H1 FY2026 interim report (balance sheet at 30 Jun 2026, note 8 EPS/share count, note 19 redemption liability, repurchase table)
data_sources.fx: Yahoo Finance CNYHKD=X, cross-checked with USDCNY=X and HKD=X

inputs.share_count_basis: Issued shares 2,595,697,618 at 1 Jan 2026 less 27,499,000 repurchased and cancelled Jan-May 2026 = 2,568.2m at 30 Jun 2026 (H1 FY2026 interim note 8 / repurchase table). Includes ~29m unvested RSU shares held by the trustee, so it is the fully diluted count (diluted EPS adds only 5.3m contingently issuable). Held FLAT because SBC is expensed in the flows. The FY2025 RMB1,418m placing is already inside this count and the cash it raised is inside net cash.
inputs.interest_income_note: Finance income RMB55.8m FY2025 (RMB48.4m H1 FY2026) is received in INVESTING activities on this filer (FY2025 cash flow: 'Interest received 40,449') and sits below profit from operations, so it is in neither reported FCF (OCF - capex) nor the EBITDA build. It is therefore already stripped; deducting it again would double-count. Recorded 0 in the owner-FCF formula for that reason.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow reconciliation 'Equity settled share-based payment expenses (Note 35)' RMB89,567k (FY2024 97,810k; FY2023 12,119k; FY2022 138,290k). No net-share-settlement tax withholding (RSU scheme settles from trustee-held shares), so equity-award taxes = 0.
inputs.buyback_note: Actual cash: RMB276.2m (HK$312.5m) H1 FY2026, RMB74.3m FY2025, RMB688.0m FY2024. A further HK$1,000m open-market buyback was authorized with the H1 FY2026 results (authorization, not spend). The company is a genuine repurchaser, so the flat count is funded.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1724 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16T22:02Z). Cross-check via USD legs: USDHKD 7.8479 / USDCNY 6.6768 = 1.1754, a 0.3% tie, which fixes the direction (1 CNY buys ~1.17 HKD). No A-share or ADR listing exists for a dual-listing parity check. All flows and per-share values computed in CNY and converted to HKD at this rate; unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv are HKD to match current_price.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in CNY: China 10y government bond ~1.8%, China equity risk premium ~6.5%, beta ~1.1 for a mid-cap innovative pharma with NRDL pricing exposure -> cost of equity ~9.0-9.5%; rounded to 9.5%. Net cash balance sheet (bank loans at 0.56-1.2% are trivial and fully covered by cash), so WACC = cost of equity. Same 9.5% in all three scenarios: regulatory (NRDL/VBP) and licensing-lumpiness risk is charged in the bear flows and the 25% bear weight, not in a premium.
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: lease liabilities RMB114.4m (56.2 current + 58.2 non-current, 30 Jun 2026) sit inside total_debt; lease principal (RMB80.8m FY2025) is NOT deducted from flows; ROU depreciation (RMB78.8m) is in D&A and lease renewal is charged through ~1pp of the capex path.
inputs.nci_treatment: NCI stock deducted once in the equity bridge (RMB63.3m book NCI plus the RMB1,223.7m redemption liability to Simcere Zaiming's outside investors); flows are consolidated 100%. NCI profit share is immaterial (-2.2m H1 FY2026). If the Zaiming spin-off IPO completes, the redemption liability converts into a listed minority stake whose value will likely exceed the 7%-accreted carrying amount, so this deduction is a floor on the leakage, not a ceiling.
inputs.capex_note: CSV CapEx = PP&E (RMB349m FY2025) + intangibles (RMB513m FY2025, mostly in-licensing upfronts). In-licensing is this company's substitute for discovery R&D and recurs (RMB406m FY2024, RMB513m FY2025, but only RMB54m additions H1 FY2026), so it is kept in capex at a normalised ~4-5% of revenue rather than excluded. Total capex 11.2% of revenue FY2025, 8.0% H1 FY2026; base path 10% gliding to 6.5%.
inputs.ebitda_note: Adjusted EBITDA here = profit from operations - other net gain/loss (FV marks on private/listed investments, which belong to the bridge assets) + D&A (owned PP&E + ROU + intangible amortisation) + SBC. FY2025: 1,555.5 - 138.4 + 380.8 + 89.6 = 1,887.5 (24.4% of revenue). H1 FY2026: 970.1 + 71.9 + 208.6 + ~45 SBC = ~1,296 (28.3%), flattered by RMB405m license income (8.8% of revenue). Other income (mainly government grants) kept in EBITDA as recurring.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component build, 10-year horizon, CNY flows converted to HKD. Routing: Simcere is an operating pharmaceutical company (product sales through a China hospital channel plus out-licensing income); it takes no deposits, holds no investment-property book and is not a holdco, so none of the bank/REIT/LIC/holdco rows apply. Non-US adaptations applied: CNY WACC, CNY/HKD fx bridge, lease treatment (A), NCI/redemption liability deducted once, investment securities in the bridge with their FV gains excluded from flows. SBC is material but small (~1.2% of revenue), so house and street bases differ modestly. No live takeover; the Simcere Zaiming (oncology) spin-off IPO is pending and is not modelled as a separate scenario. No formal revenue guidance is given in the FY2025 annual or H1 FY2026 interim reports; FY2026 growth is anchored to H1 FY2026 (+27.8% YoY) plus the Roche SIM0660 US$75m upfront signed Sept 2026.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +22%: H1 +27.8% includes RMB405m license income; H2 adds the Roche US$75m (~RMB510m) upfront against a H2 FY2025 base of RMB4,146m. FY2027 +9% laps that licensing peak. Thereafter innovative-drug ramp (QUVIVIQ, COSELA/ENLITUO/ENZESHU NRDL volume, Leruiping resubmission) offsets the -20%/yr legacy 'other fields' run-off, decelerating to 4% by year 10.
base.margin_rationale: FY2025 24.4%, H1 FY2026 ~28% with licensing at 8.8% of revenue. Base assumes licensing settles at ~6-7% of revenue and selling expense leverage adds ~2pp over the decade to 29%.
base.wc_rationale: Trade receivables ~RMB2.4bn on ~RMB9bn run-rate revenue; net operating working capital ~6-10% of revenue after accrued selling expenses, so growth consumes cash: -10% of the revenue increase.
base.tax_rationale: HNTE 15% plus R&D super-deduction; FY2025 P&L ETR 11.2% but cash tax 22.5% of PBT (withholding on license income, timing); H1 FY2026 ETR 14.5%. Cash rate 16% ramping to 18%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because revenue depends on a single payer/regulator (NRDL renewals and VBP) and on one franchise (Sanbexin). Base held at 50% as the pivot is already visible in reported numbers. Bull cut to 25% because it needs several independent things to go right: partner-run trials hitting milestones, new deals at the FY2026 pace, and margin expansion simultaneously.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
